cast.name: 丽贝卡·克拉斯尼 Rebecca Krasny

this_title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy
introduction: Going Sane tells the tumultuous and harrowing story of a 1970s LA therapy collective turned cult. Born from the self-help craze of the 1960s, the Center's transformation from hopeful beginnings to a hotbed of manipulation culminated in an internal coup, followed by the largest therapy malpractice lawsuit in California state history.
